Page with no meta description

What is this fixture? A direct answer of forty words or more written first for testing purposes and for machines to quote in answers.

  • First point
  • Second point

This page has no meta description, so search engines have to pick a snippet from the body text when they show it in results. That snippet is often a random sentence that does little to explain the page or earn the click. A good description is one or two plain sentences that say what the page offers and who it is for. It should be unique to the page and long enough to be useful without being cut off. Search engines may still rewrite it, but much less often. Write it for people first, because the description works like a short advertisement for the page.
